=👋 Welcome {{ $json.callback_query.from.first_name }}!

I'm your Job Search Assistant 🤖. I help you automate your hunt by saving your preferences and running custom scrapers.

━━━ 🛠️ HOW TO CONFIGURE ━━━

I use an incremental setup. When you trigger a search, I check if I already know your preferences.

🔹 New Users: I will ask for your search term, location, and job type step-by-step. 🔹 Existing Users: You can choose to Update your settings or Run the search immediately.

━━━ 🎓 THE "ANY ORDER" ENGINE ━━━

Whether you are in Tech, Finance, or Management, just send your details in any order. My AI detects your field and fills in the blanks for you!

━━━ ⚙️ WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? ━━━

Once your data is saved: 1️⃣ Scraping: I scan LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri, and more. 2️⃣ Delivery: You'll receive a custom CSV with all job openings.

🔗 Connect with me on LinkedIn -- https://www.linkedin.com/in/punya-jain-40ab8b2a6/
